name: double the random wait after each collision
mechanism: after a failed attempt wait a random time drawn from a window that doubles with each consecutive failure (capped), so contending parties spread out without coordination

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Exponential backoff' in section Networking:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Truncated binary exponential backoff':

fails_when: capture effect: a lucky party keeps winning
